summary: Koel is a self-hosted music streaming server (PHP/Laravel) with a community (CE) and commercial Plus split: persisted entities are the audio library (Artist/Album/Song/Genre/Folder/Transcode), user library (User/Organization/Role via Spatie, interaction play-counts, per-user Favorites and Ratings via polymorphic morphs, QueueState per-user play-queue, Playlist + playlist_song/playlist_user pivots with a role-based owner/collaborator model, PlaylistFolder hierarchy, playlist collaboration tokens), podcasts (Podcast + podcast_user subscription pivot whose episodes are Song rows), RadioStation/Theme/Embed, Settings KV, DuplicateUpload staging, agent_conversations(+messages), and Sanctum personal_access_tokens; writes and reads are exposed through a REST API (routes/api.base.php), a Subsonic-compatible API (routes/subsonic.php), and CLI scan/sync commands.
